ex.en: Frankly speaking, I don't agree with you.
ex.zh: 坦白說，我不同意你的看法。

ex.en: Frankly speaking, I actually wanted to stay at home, instead of going out.
ex.zh: 老實說，我其實想待在家，不想出門。

ex.en: He frankly expressed his own view.
ex.zh: 他坦率地表達了自己的看法。

ex.en: I envy the friendship Tom and Mary have.
ex.zh: 我很羨慕湯姆和瑪麗之間的友誼。

ex.en: I hope this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
ex.zh: 希望這是美好友誼的開始。

ex.en: By degrees the friendship between him and her grew into love.
ex.zh: 他們之間的友情慢慢發展成了愛情。

ex.en: The goods will be sent by air freight.
Freight costs have risen sharply this year.
ex.zh: 今年貨運費用大幅上漲。

ex.en: Our freight forwarder handles all the customs paperwork.
ex.zh: 我們的貨運代理負責處理所有報關文件。

ex.en: A good freight forwarder can save you time and money.
ex.zh: 好的貨運代理能幫你省時又省錢。

ex.en: He stomped on the fragile box, destroying its contents.
ex.zh: 他踐踏那箱易碎品，毀壞了裡面的物品。

ex.en: Please be careful with that box. It's fragile.
ex.zh: 請小心那個箱子，裡面是易碎品。

ex.en: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
ex.zh: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

ex.en: She has asked the person at the front desk to connect her to that number.
ex.zh: 她請櫃檯人員幫她撥那個號碼。

ex.en: Make another appointment at the front desk.
She fractured her leg while skiing.
The X-ray showed a small fracture in his arm.
ex.zh: X 光顯示他的手臂有輕微骨折。

ex.en: A hip fracture can be serious for older people.
ex.zh: 髖部骨折對長者來說可能很嚴重。
